Class SessionSummary

java.lang.Object
com.group22.reportnow.model.SessionSummary
public class SessionSummary extends Object
Stores a summary of a ReportNow session. Contains the student, project and activity statistics used when displaying previous sessions.

  • Constructor Details

    • SessionSummary

      public SessionSummary()
      Creates an empty session summary. This allows Jackson to load information from saved JSON reports.

    • SessionSummary

      public SessionSummary(String studentId, String projectName, String sessionId, long sessionStartMs, long sessionDurationMs, int totalCompilations, int successfulCompilations, int failedCompilations, int totalExecutionAttempts, int successfulExecutions, int failedExecutions, long activeTimeMs, long idleTimeMs, long typingCadenceMs, double editsPerMinute)
      Creates a session summary using the recorded session statistics.
      Parameters:
      studentId - the student's ID
      projectName - the name of the project
      sessionId - the unique ID of the session
      sessionStartMs - the session start time in milliseconds
      sessionDurationMs - the total session duration in milliseconds
      totalCompilations - the total number of compilation attempts
      successfulCompilations - the number of successful compilations
      failedCompilations - the number of failed compilations
      totalExecutionAttempts - the total number of execution attempts
      successfulExecutions - the number of successful executions
      failedExecutions - the number of failed executions
      activeTimeMs - the estimated active time in milliseconds
      idleTimeMs - the estimated idle time in milliseconds
      typingCadenceMs - the estimated time between detected edits
      editsPerMinute - the estimated number of detected edits per minute
